Full collector photograph visually transcribed and compared with the English printed face. The Japanese refers to the location card's “text,” where the English says “game texts.” Both printed faces also reverse Expand The Empire when present and restore the location's orientation if Revolution is canceled. Publication ID 1301_62o follows the approved Japanese catalog; this is not a GEMP implementation claim. Source preservation remains pending.
